matrix_index_interpretation: Retrospective inventory of the three predeclared standalone setup replacements. This file did not launch a matrix. The original natural index remains unchanged with three strictly unstarted errors and zero model scores. Original controls are reused and are not new runs.
native_and_causal_review_author: pulse_trials plus preserved materials first-trial review; archive agent rehashed every cited artifact and read the sealed ledger

trials_detail.reason: The final model derives whole-body displacement from closed-system center-of-energy conservation: normalized displacement equals energy-weighted group transit delay minus vacuum transit L. It replaces the canonical-momentum expression L*average[(1-n)*ng] while retaining the exact energy spectrum, matched-interface optics and group index. Bounded affine weighted least squares identifies the common oscillator strength without a truth constant. All7 verifier tests pass.
trials_detail.trajectory_qualification: Complete emitted messages,11 tool calls and outputs reviewed. Step7 tests calibration fits; step9 confirms transit-only data; step10 publicly states the center-of-energy relation before applying it. The combined delete/add patch is rejected at10; the update patch succeeds at11 with the same physical formula. Step12 passes public tests and checks both observables. Step13 has a malformed tool input and14 finds /app is not a Git repository; neither changes code. Step15 compiles and recovers a synthetic common parameter. No surviving physical, mathematical or implementation confound.

trials_detail.reason: The final model uses whole-body excess group delay, L times the energy-weighted average of n_g minus one, instead of the starter canonical-momentum expression L*average[(1-n)*n_g]. It retains the exact pulse-energy spectrum and matched-interface optical response, and estimates f by bounded affine weighted least squares. The repaired displacement law is the center-of-energy result for the specified isolated complete body. All 7 verifier tests pass.
trials_detail.trajectory_qualification: All 13 public tool calls, emitted public messages, final source and diagnostic outputs reviewed. Bulk displayed calibration values are preserved in the hashed trajectory and match the unchanged public data artifact. Step 7 identifies all 288 measurements as transit. Step 10 uses width rather than normalized quadrature weights in a scratch diagnostic; steps 11-12 correct that calculation and obtain the final parameter. Step 13 publicly identifies the displacement repair, although it loosely calls the underlying law center-of-mass conservation. The actual code and attempted patch use the correct center-of-energy displacement relation. The combined delete/add patch at step 14 is rejected, then the update patch succeeds at step 15. Steps 16-17 pass public tests, compile and exercise the API. The scratch error and rejected patch do not survive in the submission. No physical, mathematical or implementation confound affects the pass.

trials_detail.reason: The final model explicitly uses total center-of-energy conservation to predict normalized whole-body displacement as L times the energy-weighted average of n_g minus one. The affine basis shares the same f coefficient between displacement and transit, whose extra intercept is L. It uses the exact (1-u^2)^8 energy weight and estimates f from the noisy calibration by bounded weighted least squares. All 7 verifier tests pass.
trials_detail.trajectory_qualification: All 10 public tool calls, emitted public messages, final source and diagnostic outputs reviewed. The large calibration display was already truncated by the original tool; its public data artifact and displayed transcript remain preserved and hashed. Step 5 searches the public /app files but finds no hidden hint or solution. Missing jq at step 6 is followed by a Python diagnostic at step 7; its empty displacement subset raises a harmless min() error after identifying transit-only calibration. Step 8 publicly states the correct excess-delay law and obtains the fitted parameter. A combined delete/add patch at step 10 is rejected, then the update succeeds at step 11. Step 12 passes the public test and checks both observables; a Git diagnostic at step 13 only reports that /app is not a repository. Step 14 compiles the final source. The optional pre-fit midpoint fallback is not the fitted parameter and does not affect the documented fit-then-predict protocol. No surviving physics or implementation confound affects the pass.
